messages:
aj: Quick question — should we pick a single canonical HTTP status for 'server chose a lower-capacity model / routing degraded but still returned content'?

katie: My first instinct is 503 (service unavailable) + Retry-After, because it's a server-side degrade, not a client rate limit.

noah: +1 to 503, but we need to be explicit about machine-readable fields. Clients need to know if they got a lower-quality model vs hard failure.

maria: Proposal: 503 with headers: `Retry-After`, `X-RW-Degradation: soft|hard`, `X-RW-Fallback-Model: redwood-7b-q4` and a JSON body field `error_type: "routing_degraded"`. That keeps HTTP semantics while giving SDKs clear signals.

aj: Example body sketch: ```json
{
  "error": "service_degraded",
  "error_type": "routing_degraded",
  "fallback_model": "redwood-7b-q4",
  "suggested_retry_seconds": 10
}
```

noah: For telemetry we should emit both HTTP status and an internal tag `route_decision: degraded->fallback_variant` so console can show per-route quality regressions.

maria: UI ask: Console should badge routes with a yellow 'degraded' pill when >5% of requests in last 5m had `routing_degraded`. Also surface a quick link to the failing model variants and the recent rollout that touched routing.

katie: Important: do NOT convert client-visible 429 semantics. 429 = client exceeded quota/rate. 503 = server-side capacity/routing. Mixing them will confuse retry logic.

aj: Agreed. Also for SDKs: map 503+routing_degraded -> Retryable but with backoff; include `retry_after` if present. 429 remains immediate backoff case.

deploy-bot: Notice: canary rollout to region-us-west applied 3m ago, routing policy bumped to prefer small-queue nodes.

maria: Can we also add a short human-friendly message for the body for developers? e.g., "Request served by lower-capacity variant; consider retrying or pinning model"

noah: One edge-case: long-running streaming responses. We should send an initial 200 with a streaming info frame if degrade is flagged mid-stream, otherwise clients won't know. Suggest sending a control event `{ "info": "degraded_to_variant", "variant": "redwood-3b" }` on the stream.

katie: Action items: (1) eng-platform to land header + body contract, (2) SDKs to map behaviors (retry/backoff), (3) console to implement degraded badge + telemetry chart, (4) runtime to emit `route_decision` tags.

aj: I'll draft the RFC today and include the header names and sample SDK pseudocode. Will ping for reviews. :thumbsup:
